en: Deals {base_coefficient}% ATK as Water damage. If Water Element is present at attack start, adds {conditional_coefficient}% ATK.
Deals {base_coefficient}% ATK as Water damage, plus {per_water_coefficient}% ATK for each Water Element consumed.
If Water Element is present at attack start, increases damage dealt by {damage_increase}%.
Increases this character's Water damage by {damage_increase}% for {duration} turns. Cooldown: {cooldown} turns.
If Lingering Surge is held, this 3 or 4 Match attack deals {damage_increase}% more final damage and consumes Lingering Surge after the attack.
Consuming {required_water} Water Elements at once grants one Lingering Surge. A 5 Match attack neither uses nor consumes it. The next 3 or 4 Match attack deals {damage_increase}% more final damage.
Predator's Instinct damage increase changes from {passive_before}% to {passive_after}%.

3 Match changes from {match3_before}% to {match3_after}% ATK. 4 Match base changes from {match4_base_before}% to {match4_base_after}% ATK, and its Water Element bonus changes from {match4_conditional_before}% to {match4_conditional_after}% ATK.
Time of Devouring's coefficient per consumed Water Element changes from {per_water_before}% to {per_water_after}% ATK.

Consuming {required_water} Water Elements at once grants one Lingering Surge. It persists until the next 3 or 4 Match attack, increases that attack's final damage by {damage_increase}%, and is then consumed. A 5 Match attack neither uses nor consumes it.
